findings.title: Container fails
findings.cause: container migrate exited with code 3 (the app reported an error); its log says: "migration lock is held by another run"; Job migrate's podFailurePolicy matched that exit and failed the whole Job at once, without the retries backoffLimit allows (Container migrate for pod kd-job-pod-failure-policy/migrate-rmtbc failed with exit code 3 matching FailJob rule at index 0)

evidence.what: last lines of container migrate's log (current run)
evidence.detail: migration lock is held by another run
Container migrate for pod kd-job-pod-failure-policy/migrate-rmtbc failed with exit code 3 matching FailJob rule at index 0

findings.fix: Fix what the log reports; the process exits on its own, so the cause is in the app or its configuration. The Job's podFailurePolicy marks this exit as not worth retrying; if it can succeed on a retry, change that rule's action to Ignore or Count.
